rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip code and located the user’s orders. However, it executed an exchange (write action) without first restating the exact change and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Additionally, the agent stated specific item IDs and a refund amount without visible support in the tool outputs provided (the order details were truncated), risking fabrication/unsupported details. While the requested exchange appears to have been performed, the lack of explicit confirmation and potentially unsupported final details mean the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
